handoff.salientSummary: Implemented Redis client for status caching with TTL (24h). Created helper functions for status key patterns (eval:status:{id}, eval:progress:{id}) and connection pool support. All 13 tests pass and validators successful.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created Redis client package in internal/cache with NewRedisClient constructor connecting to localhost:3106. Implemented StatusKey and ProgressKey helper functions following pattern eval:status:{id} and eval:progress:{id}. Created SetStatus, GetStatus, SetProgress, GetProgress methods with 24-hour TTL automatically applied. Added DeleteStatus, DeleteProgress, Ping, Close, GetTTL, and IsKeyNotFound helper methods. Connection pool uses go-redis default settings (10 connections per CPU core, max 3 retries, 4s pool timeout). All 13 test cases pass covering connection, CRUD operations, TTL verification, key pattern validation, and concurrent connection pool handling.

commandsRun.observation: All 13 test cases passed: TestRedisClientConnection, TestRedisClientSetAndGetStatus, TestRedisClientGetStatusNotFound, TestRedisClientSetAndGetProgress, TestRedisClientGetProgressNotFound, TestRedisClientTTL, TestRedisClientProgressTTL, TestRedisClientStatusKeyPattern, TestRedisClientProgressKeyPattern, TestRedisClientUpdateStatus, TestRedisClientUpdateProgress, TestRedisClientSetStatusAndProgress, TestRedisClientConnectionPoolSettings
